hooks.name: Rebuild sandbox after scan changes
hooks.description: When the agent edits how graves are found, rebuild the sandbox and ask it to compare the scan with the expected graves.

action.prompt: You changed grave detection. Run ./scripts/sandbox.sh, then `node bin/graveyard.js scan --json` inside ../graveyard-sandbox. Check that it still finds: lost commits from reset --hard, the deleted feature/payments branch, the big refactor, the dying experiment (under 1 day left), the edited-lines commit, the dropped stash on main, and the util.js ghost. Report any grave that is missing or has a wrong headline, summary, origin or time left.
